findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_guide · Private data: search_addresses, get_address, street_price_per_m2, price_check, buyer_checks, find_address_from_sale_history, district_statistics · Public sink: address_report, area_overview, compare_areas, district_statistics.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_guide · Private data: search_addresses, get_address, street_price_per_m2, price_check, buyer_checks, find_address_from_sale_history, district_statistics · Public sink: address_report, area_overview, compare_areas, district_statistics

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
